newsitem.title: UK: European jet fuel trundles sideways in quiet markeT.
newsitem.headline: European jet fuel trundles sideways in quiet markeT.

text.p: European jet fuel prices were broadly unchanged on Wednesday amid steady gas oil futures and modest demand.
May IPE gas oil was flat at $166.50 a tonne at 1505 GMT.

Barge premiums have been underpinned by the German tender to buy 250,000 tonnes of jet fuel between May and September and levels were talked around May IPE gas oil +$20 fob. Cargoes, which have not derived as much support from the tender, were having trouble securing homes when offered in the low +$20s cif NWE.
In the Mediterranean EU spec material was ranged between high fob Med quotes +$6-9 with non EU grade $2-3 below this.
